description: Set the selling content on an offer's checkout page — described, not designed: your words render into gocushy's fixed, conversion-tested layout, so you can fully customise without ever breaking it. Good direct-response structure: headline = the outcome, bullets = benefits, testimonial = real and specific, guarantee = concrete terms. The checkout object REPLACES the existing blocks — always pass every field you want to keep; pass checkout: null to reset entirely. This also sets a per-offer `checkout_logo_url` (a logo at the very top of this checkout, overriding the account logo) and edits the ONE-CLICK UPSELL page copy (headline, body, and the accept/decline button labels) — pass only the fields you want to change; omit `checkout` entirely to edit just those.

accent.description: Brand hex colour; light shades rejected (button text is white)

bullets.description: Benefits, not features — what the buyer GETS

deadline.description: ISO datetime; renders an HONEST countdown that disappears when passed and never resets. Only set real deadlines.

body.description: Specific beats vague: state exactly what happens on refund

headline.description: Outcome-focused headline, e.g. 'Launch your course in 30 days' — not the product name

image_url.description: Brand/course BANNER image. Renders full-width at the top of the story column (or, in the 'hero' layout, as a full-width banner across the whole checkout). Width-driven — use a WIDE image; height follows naturally, so exact height doesn't matter.

layout.description: Checkout template: 'standard' = form left, story+price right (default, best all-rounder); 'compact' = single narrow column for quick buys; 'hero' = full-width image banner on top (needs image_url), two columns below

testimonials.description: REAL testimonials only — fabricating them violates the acceptable use policy

checkout_logo_url.description: Logo at the very TOP of this offer's checkout (~46px tall), overriding the account logo — for per-offer / per-brand logos. HTTPS only.

project.description: Set/replace the offer project label for grouping; empty string clears it. Reuse existing names exactly (see list_offers).

upsell_button_label.description: Upsell accept-button text, e.g. 'Yes — add the coaching call'

upsell_decline_label.description: Upsell decline-link text, e.g. 'No thanks, I'll pass'

name: update_checkout
title: Customize a checkout
